From: Marvin Eliza Trujillo

To: IPI NY
Subject: INVITATION: Norway re-opens the UN Security Council Chamber on April 16th
Importance: High




Dear colleagues,




Please note you are all invited and are welcome to bring your spouse or guest to the April 16th Norwegian reopening of
the Security Council Chamber (invite below).




If you will attend and bring a guest, please RSVP by no later than 2pm tomorrow, April 11th. Please provide your guest's
full name and affiliation (if applicable).




If you DON'T HAVE A UN pass, the entrance and security screening will be on the 42nd Street entrance on 1st Avenue
directly across from the Tudor City stairs. YOU MUST BRING IDENTIFICATION! If you have an NGO UN pass, you must still
enter as a non-UN pass holder.




Feel free to contact me if you have any questions.




Best,

Marvin Eliza
